newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $66- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $66- USDA.

text.p: Trade turned moderate in the Panhandle area late Thursday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 10,300 slaughter steers and 4,400 heifers, with 33,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,700 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00.
Pen Select/few Choice 2-4 1150-1175 lbs and heiferettes 63.00.
Wk to date - 33,600 Week Ago - 69,000 Year Ago - 66,800
